escape_underscores option escapes underscores in plain text

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>The variable_name is defined.</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(escape_underscores: true))
puts result.content.inspect
```
